shared_elements: rectilinear/blocky forms arranged in panels or bands along a broadly horizontal surface
justification: Both surfaces bear repeated schematic, rectilinear geometric motifs grouped into panel-like clusters running along a horizontal surface, which is about as generic a correspondence as decorated surfaces can share. A, however, centres on a naturalistic animal skull with horns set against small repeated dash-and-chevron marks, whereas B shows only bold carved abstract blocks, step-like frames and grooved bands with no recognisable creature or body part.
